mainEntity.name: What is a prosthodontist and how is it different from a regular dentist?

acceptedAnswer.text: A prosthodontist is a dental specialist with an additional 3 years of post-doctoral training beyond dental school, focused on restoring and replacing teeth. At Makris Dental Prosthodontics in Lake Nona, Dr. Elizabeta Cokovska is a board-certified prosthodontist specializing in dental implants, full-mouth reconstruction, cosmetic dentistry, and complex restorative cases that general dentists typically refer out.

mainEntity.name: Can I get a dental implant in one day in Orlando?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Makris Dental Prosthodontics in Lake Nona, Orlando offers one-day dental implants for single tooth replacement and Same Day Smile treatment for full arch restoration in as little as 24 hours. Using 3D guided implant technology, Dr. Cokovska can often extract a failing tooth and place the implant in the same appointment.

mainEntity.name: What is All-on-X or All-on-4 dental implants?

acceptedAnswer.text: All-on-X (also called All-on-4) is a full arch dental implant procedure where 4 to 6 implants are placed in the jaw to support a complete fixed bridge of teeth. It is a permanent, stable alternative to traditional dentures. Makris Dental Prosthodontics in Orlando offers All-on-X with same-day teeth in select cases.

mainEntity.name: Does Makris Dental offer sedation dentistry for anxious patients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Makris Dental Prosthodontics offers oral sedation and nitrous oxide (laughing gas) for patients with dental anxiety. Our team in Lake Nona, Orlando is experienced in making dental visits comfortable and stress-free, even for complex procedures like implants or full mouth reconstruction.
